summary: Iteration 13: tested Progress & streaks (GET /api/me/progress plus the dashboard card), the re-verified events (source_checked badges, MetroWorks removed), the brand kit zip, logos and favicon, and the mobile dashboard. Backend: 31/31 passed (8 new iteration-13 tests plus the iteration 11-12 regression tests). Frontend: all requested flows passed.

minor.issue: The 'mock' nudge ('run one mock interview') still shows when the user already has mock sessions this week (this_week.mock=2). This happens because totals.mocks only counts sessions marked complete. The nudge text is misleading for users who started but did not finish a mock.

issues: brand-logo loads /brand/icon-512.png (512px) for a roughly 28px icon. A smaller asset would load faster (minor).

action_items: Optional: change the mock nudge condition or text so users with an unfinished mock are told to finish it, not to start one
critical_code_review_comments: my_progress: each saved job adds at most one 'applied' event, timestamped with the latest status_updated_at. Moving a job applied→interviewed later re-dates that job's 'applied' activity to the newer week. This is fine for streaks but inflates the 'applied this week' count.
ProgressCard swallows API errors and renders nothing (no error state). This is acceptable but silent.
seed_data_creation: One throwaway user (test_prog_*@example.com) was registered and then deleted via DELETE /api/me. Login after deletion is rejected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: delivered@resend.dev has 1 saved job (Library Page), status 'interviewed'. It was toggled to applied and back to interviewed via the UI, and each change triggered a /me/progress refresh. Events: 8 total, all source_checked 2026-11-06; 6 youth and 5 immigrant (audience filtered, which is why the default Youth view shows 6 badges). Zip is 970610 bytes, application/zip. Mobile dashboard scrollWidth is 390 (no overflow). The only console error was a 401 on /auth/me before login, which is expected.
